# fael-plan spec — the how, as plan sections

Add `## ` sections to the plan doc after Constraints, one per topic — API contract, entity
states, edge cases, example input/output, and fail examples that make the boundaries clear. More
concrete examples than abstract. Each is a section with its own key and title, sent alone
through the bill (`SKILL.md` Phase 2) — the plan doc is the only spec:

```bash
jq --rawfile b api.md '.sections = [{key:"api",title:"API contract",body:$b}]' bill.json > bill2.json
fael plan apply bill2.json --dry-run && fael plan apply bill2.json
```

A chunk that works from one names it: `fael chunk add … --reads api` (or `chunk edit <uid>
--reads api`); its brief prints that section in full and only lists the rest.
